title: Echo Shard on Graves: can it go on Borrowed Decree, and what does it give on Grasping Hands?
question: Game data marks Echo Shard IMBUE_ACTIVE_NON_ULT. Does the imbue UI refuse Decree, and does Echo on Hands give an immediate second Hands (2 ghouls each at T3)?
hypothesis: H-GU-1: Decree cannot be selected as Echo's imbue target. On Hands T3, activating Echo right after Hands allows a second Hands within 1s; Echo's cooldown after use = 30s + Hands' current cooldown (~16-20s).

arms.name: echo_hands
arms.notes: abil 1 15 / 2 15 / 3 3 / 4 15 bits (real tiers at 36.8k: Jar T3, Hands T3, Theft T1, Decree T3)

setup.position: open ground, 3 stationary bots in a line 10m away

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Try to imbue Echo Shard on Decree; record whether the UI accepts it (echo arm only)
Cast Hands, then Echo, then Hands; record time between the two Hands casts, ghouls raised and total Hands damage in 10s
Record Echo's cooldown shown after use

metrics.name: hands_damage_10s
metrics.how: damage numbers sum / bot HP lost

decision.rule: If Decree imbue is accepted, REFUTES the non-ult reading: revisit the build. If echo_hands deals >=40% more Hands damage in 10s (prediction ~+100%), SUPPORTS Echo on Hands; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE and Echo's slot is re-opened against Refresher-in-core.
